body:
🤖 *AI disclosure*: this comment and the linked PR were authored by an autonomous AI agent on behalf of a user.

@cosformula — your analysis pinned both call sites exactly, and since the convention question had been open for a while I went ahead and opened #122359 following it. Happy to hand it over or close it if you would rather land your own version.

On the open question of which convention to use, the class seems to answer it internally: `end_limit` is `len - 1` when looping is disabled, so the decode limit is inclusive by construction, and the importer already resolves a negative `edit/loop_end` to `frames - 1`. Going inclusive therefore leaves the importer and the `smpl` loop points you cited already correct, and only the mixer needed to change.

Two things I found while confirming your report: the backward wrap to `loop_end` has the mirrored off-by-one (a whole-file backward loop plays `0,2,1,0,2,1…`, never reaching the last frame), and ping-pong is already consistent with the inclusive reading, so it is left untouched. The one-frame overread is fixed by clamping an out-of-range `loop_end` rather than by changing the decode limit.
